list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM trade_aggregates ORDER BY symbol

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, symbol, vwap FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND ($__all OR symbol IN ($symbol)) ORDER BY window_start
SELECT symbol, AVG(vwap) as vwap FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY symbol
SELECT symbol, SUM(total_volume) as volume FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY volume DESC
SELECT window_start AS time, symbol, trade_count FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY window_start

SELECT window_start AS time, symbol || ' High' as metric, max_price as value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND ($__all OR symbol IN ($symbol)) ORDER BY window_start

SELECT window_start AS time, symbol || ' Low' as metric, min_price as value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND ($__all OR symbol IN ($symbol)) ORDER BY window_start
